== Biography ==
Ann was born about 1839. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2603|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Lamb-11245|Mary Lamb]]. She passed away in 1904.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 93% (confident). Ann Glasgow's baptism on 18 December 1839 at Manchester Cathedral is indexed (two copies of one entry) to Robert Glasgow and Mary, and Robert [[Glasgow-2603]]'s will in the 1876-77 Wellington probate file names his daughter Ann Hogg. The baptism fits her 1839 Lancashire birth, raising the father link from 76% to 93% proved.

Baptism index transcript only; register uninspected. Her cited 1920 death number duplicating Mary Knox's remains an unrelated citation error against her 1904 death. No mother change follows.
<ref>[https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1859/2665 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages)].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/189039485 England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975 — Ann Glasgow, 18 Dec 1839, Cathedral,Manchester,Lancashire,England].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/101712439 England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975 — Ann Glasgow, 18 Dec 1839, Manchester, Lancaster, England].</ref><ref>[https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1866/6424 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages) married Mary Stewart].</ref>

The dated reviews below describe earlier stages of this research.


=== Earlier father review, 22 October 2026 ===

In this earlier review, the father [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 76% (probable). The held account assigns Ann (Glasgow) Hogg to Robert Glasgow and Mary Lamb in the Bombay/Turakina family. Ann’s 1839 Lancashire birth fits, but her cited 1920/10746 death number duplicates Mary Knox’s and contradicts her 1904 death.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Earlier proposed test: Inspect the 1842 Bombay passenger family list and the child’s NZ death certificate parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages NZ marriage registration 1859/2665 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Dmarriages)]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
